tips.text: Run normal and solo unless your Duviri loadout is strong; Steel Path takes 20 to 25 minutes against about 15.
Skip pub squads; extra players mostly add boss health and AFK teammates slow the objectives.
Wall-cling or go Operator Void Mode during Oraxia's spider phase; Death Scuttlers disable abilities and the hanging ones proc Magnetic on contact.
Enter the Circuit and play one round on a bad loadout to reroll it, or abort after the run ends to keep rewards and the rotation.
Expect the forced Undercroft Survival to take a flat 5 minutes; it is the slowest part of a run.
Expect Oraxia's arena effects and web shots to hit very hard on Steel Path, especially on low-armor frames.
Bring Subsuming Silence to keep Oraxia on the floor for melee damage.
Let the parts drop first and spend Scuttler Husks only on the pieces that refuse to.
Farm it in one sitting alongside Oraxia and Scyotid and let the random drops cover what they cover.
Expect about 5 to 6 runs to guarantee the full set from husks alone; drops usually cut that down.
Players call this one of the easiest modern farms; the complaints are about recycled Duviri content, not the grind.
